text: {"lessons":["I should judge each stock by its future prospects and role in my overall portfolio, not by whether it is above or below my purchase price.","Selling winners and later buying back at higher prices shows that recent gains or losses are not reliable signals; I should avoid reacting to price moves alone.","I should set clear, diversified position sizes and stick to them, rather than letting reluctance to admit a mistake or attachment to separate stock accounts drive my decisions."]}
